images.filename: Northern Constabulary Pipe Band at Cowal Highland Games Dunoon Scotland (4949923566).jpg
images.caption:
Band in the competition Arena

The Band took part in the last "Major" Pipe Band Competition of the 2010 season. It was primarily a learning experience, especially for the younger/newer members of the Band. The weather was "varied", and the low tide in the evening meant our bus could not get back to Gourock on the ferry and we had to take the long way round by road.
